# Chamuka Labs

> Chamuka Labs is an applied AI lab: we ship AI-native products, put research into practice, and build tools for AI agents.

Website: https://chamuka-inc.github.io/
Organization: https://github.com/chamuka-inc
Lab site: https://chamuka.ai
License: Apache-2.0
Work and general: dev@chamuka.ai
Security and conduct: security@chamuka.ai
Brand system: Daybreak (https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-design)

DrawIt is an experiment under agent and human interaction. A canvas you and the model both edit. From thoughts to form. Coming soon as open source. That line is DrawIt's only, never the lab's. There is no public repository yet.

Hire us: we build AI-native products and agent tooling for teams. Email dev@chamuka.ai.

This file expands the brief catalogue in /llms.txt with each public repository's description and a short README summary. It does not invent features. Research means applied engineering only: no papers, benchmarks, or evaluation claims.

## What we do

- Products: AI-native products. The model is in the artefact, not a chat panel on the side.
- Applied research: engineering that puts methods into running systems.
- Tools for agents: isolation, credentials, skills, and runtimes.

## Experiments

### Agent and human interaction

#### DrawIt

A canvas you and the model both edit. From thoughts to form. Coming soon as open source. No public repository.

### Other experiments

#### FormIt

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-formit
- Description: Form builder for creating, managing, and collecting responses to surveys and forms.
- Summary: Multi-page form creation with text, single-choice, and multiple-choice questions; draft, publish, and archive states; public share links; and a drag-and-drop builder. Built with Next.js, tRPC, PostgreSQL, and NextAuth. Demo: https://chamuka-formit.vercel.app

#### Waypoint

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-waypoint
- Description: Desktop workspace for evidence-led career research.
- Summary: A personal career research desktop app for investigating direct-fit, adjacent, and stretch opportunities with source evidence and next steps. Implemented with Wails 2 and Go, SQLite, and TypeScript. Site: https://chamuka-inc.github.io/chamuka-waypoint/

## Tools for agents

### Vmette

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-vmette
- Description: Hardware-isolated microVM sandbox for running local AI agents on macOS.
- Summary: Runs untrusted agent work in a hardware-isolated Linux VM on the local Mac, using Apple's Virtualization.framework rather than a container that shares the host kernel. Network is off until `--net`. Also exposed as an MCP server. Docs: https://chamuka-inc.github.io/chamuka-vmette/

### Conduit

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-conduit
- Description: Declarative action layer for AI agents over REST and MCP.
- Summary: Turns third-party SaaS APIs into callable, schema-typed actions, discoverable as LLM tools and over an MCP server. A new integration is a set of declarative manifests, not a code change. Credential storage is delegated to CredVault.

### CredVault

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-credvault
- Description: Multi-tenant credential vault for AI agent integrations.
- Summary: Stores per-end-user OAuth tokens and API keys for many providers, encrypts them at rest, and keeps them valid across expiry, rotation, and revocation so a caller can request a valid access token for a user at a provider.

### Agent Run

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-agent-run
- Description: Unattended runner for coding agents with rate-limit retry and verify-fix loops.
- Summary: A non-interactive CLI (`claude-run`) that orchestrates coding agent sessions. Subcommands include a rate-limit retry wrapper, a generic verify-fix loop, an adversarial spec-compliance reviewer, and a YAML pipeline.

### Skills

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-skills
- Description: Reusable skills and reference guides for coding agents.
- Summary: A Claude Code plugin of reusable agent skills: techniques, patterns, and reference guides. Each skill is a SKILL.md that conforms to the Agent Skills specification.

### Plane

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-plane
- Description: Ephemeral compute platform built on Plane and OCI containers, with tiered isolation.
- Summary: A hard fork of jamsocket/plane. Adds an in-sandbox HTTP daemon, an egress proxy, operator tooling, and OCI runtime images around the upstream controller, drone, and proxy.

## Design system

### Daybreak

- Repository: https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-design
- Description: Daybreak, the Chamuka Labs design system: tokens, React components, brand assets.
- Summary: Brand infrastructure for Chamuka Labs, not a product. Packages: @chamuka/tokens (DTCG JSON to CSS variables and Tailwind themes), @chamuka/ui (React 19 components), and @chamuka/icons (Daybreak mark and lockups). Logo masters, print, and voice live under /brand. Voice: founder-led, short, specific, slightly dry. Feel: playful, warm, African-rooted — not toy-like.
